name: eyeposture-monorepo
description: EyePosture - Commercial Desktop Screen Wellness Assistant

scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npx esbuild api/serverless.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=api/index.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('api/index.js', 'apps/api/index.js'); fs.mkdirSync('apps/api/api', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('api/index.js', 'apps/api/api/index.js');"
scripts.package:win: npm run build -w @eyeposture/desktop && npx electron-packager apps/desktop EyePosture --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --icon=EyePosture.ico --out=release --overwrite --no-prune
scripts.installer:win: npm run package:win && npx -y electron-builder@24.13.3 --win nsis --prepackaged release/EyePosture-win32-x64 --config electron-builder.json
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @eyeposture/shared-types && npm run build -w @eyeposture/billing && npm run build -w @eyeposture/database && npm run build -w @eyeposture/reminder-engine && npm run build -w @eyeposture/vision && npm run build -w @eyeposture/i18n && npm run build -w @eyeposture/api
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @eyeposture/desktop
